cim_eredeti: From Ideas to Prototypes with Codex | Shopify’s Mikhail Parakhin
szoveg_eredeti:
“If you have an idea, bring a prototype right away.” For Shopify CTO Mikhail Parakhin, Codex is changing what his team brings to the meeting. From delegating tasks to exploring architectural options, he’s using Codex to take on work he couldn’t before. Meet Mikhail, one of the builders in Codex Originals.

Building with Codex? Share your story: https://openai.com/form/codex-originals/
